text:
samir: deploybot blocked a staging publish to us-east-1. provenance.guard rejected due to missing build_id and empty attestation predicateType. image=redwood/frontend:staging-2026-03-20, digest=sha256:beefcafe...

ci-bot: build pipeline report: step `emit-provenance` returned 0 but produced empty annotations file on retry. logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/12345

jen: is this the new retry dedupe change? we updated the builder to skip artifact writes when duplicate artifacts detected. could be skipping annotations.

samir: release window is 09:00-11:00 UTC. If we can't have a promoted image by 10:30UTC we should pin and continue canary. No fresh build unless republish fails.

deploy-bot: enforcement: promote-checker requires `provenance.require_build_id=true`. promotion aborted when missing.

jen: i can try a corrective republish to the same tag with the annotations injected. prefer to avoid a full rebuild.

samir: two options: (A) manual republish + cosign attestation attach (fast), or (B) pin to previous digest and schedule republish after the window. Which is safer?

release-mgr: go with pin for the immediate canary. Keep a scheduled republish attempt at 12:00 UTC. If that succeeds and cosign verifies, we'll retag and forward-roll during next window. Document the pin in release notes and add audit entry.

ops-oncall: logged incident INC-2026-0424. I'll create the audit entry and add the temporary pin tag in the deployment ledger.

jen: manual republish commands i'm using locally:
```
# inject annotations
jq '.annotations.build_id="bk-99999" | .annotations["builder"]="buildkite"' manifest.raw > manifest.withmeta.json
# push manifest into ECR
aws ecr put-image --repository redwood/frontend --image-manifest file://manifest.withmeta.json --image-tag staging-2026-03-20
# attach cosign attestation
cosign attach-attestation --predicate-file att.json --image eu.gcr.io/redwood/frontend@sha256:beefcafe...
```

samir: note: cosign attestation must include predicateType `https://slsa.dev/provenance/v0.2` (or our internal build predicate) or promote-checker will reject. ci-bot flagged attestation predicateType missing earlier.

deploy-bot: advisory: promotes check both manifest annotations and attestation predicate types. mismatches cause silent reject.

release-mgr: Decision: pin to previous digest sha256:dadc0ffe... for canary/promote. Jen to attempt republish at 12:00 UTC. If republish verifies, we'll coordinate retag during the 16:00 UTC change window.

jen: opened PR updating release manifest references and release notes: https://git.internal/r/redwood/releases/pull/462

ops-oncall: audit note added: "temporary pin due to missing build_id in provenance; republish scheduled by jen at 12:00 UTC; RCA owner=jen".

samir: jen please also follow up with a unit-test for the retry path and add a small e2e that validates annotations present before finish.

jen: will do, pushing patch now and adding tests. I'll report back in this thread after republish attempt.

deploy-bot: background: promote-config snippet for reference: `{"require_build_id": true, "required_predicate_types": ["https://slsa.dev/provenance/v0.2"]}`

samir: thanks everyone. closing once republish result and PR merge are recorded.
